question: Tattvabodhini Sabha was founded in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1839**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tattvabodhini Sabha was founded in 1839 in Calcutta (now Kolkata), India.
 
• The Sabha was established by Debendranath Tagore, father of the famous poet Rabindranath Tagore.
 
• Its main objective was to promote the religious and social ideas of the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• The Tattvabodhini Sabha played a significant role in the Bengal Renaissance by encouraging rational thinking and modern education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahmo Samaj**

 
 
• Founded in 1828 by Raja Ram Mohan Roy, the Brahmo Samaj was a reform movement of Hinduism.
 
• It emphasized monotheism, rationalism, and modern education.
 
• The movement aimed to eliminate social evils like Sati and child marriage.
 
 
 
• **Bengal Renaissance**
 
 
• A period of social and cultural reform in Bengal during the 19th and early 20th centuries.
 
• Marked by a revival of interest in Indian culture, coupled with a strong influence of Western ideas.
 
• Key figures included Raja Ram Mohan Roy, Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar, and Rabindranath Tagore.
 
 
 
• **Debendranath Tagore**
 
 
• One of the leading figures of the Brahmo Samaj after Raja Ram Mohan Roy.
 
• He founded the Tattvabodhini Sabha to propagate the teachings of the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• He was instrumental in the spread of Brahmoism in Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Social Reforms**
 
 
• The Tattvabodhini Sabha contributed to various social reforms, including education and women's rights.
 
• The Sabha's journal, Tattvabodhini Patrika, was a significant medium for spreading reformist ideas.
